outcome_statement: Browser playback behaviour was observed for 1 of 8 Spanish official broadcaster targets (CCMA/3Cat TV3): its HTML media element, Bitmovin engine and HLS manifest/segment request sequence were captured in the REA-managed Chromium. For RTVE, Mediaset, Atresplayer and Canal Sur, pages loaded but no media request, no <video> element and no player-library initialisation were observed inside the bounded capture window, and every attempt to extend the window or add a play click failed with a REA provider/client deadline; they are recorded as not_observed, not as 'no playback'. ETB, CRTVG and À Punt were not attempted at all. No playback claim is made for any provider beyond what is listed under observed. No DRM, geo-block, authentication, paywall, cookie-consent, challenge or ad-wall was circumvented, and no credentials, cookies, tokens or query values were recorded.

method.capture_shape_used: capture_browser_scenario with browser.mode='launch'; actions = one wait_for_timeout; capture.at_end=['url','dom'] (or ['url'] only); events = console/page-errors/network/frames; request_body, response_body and header_values all FALSE (no bodies, no header values retained)

privacy.note: REA reports query PARAMETER NAMES for retention; this index and the summarizer redact or drop credential-like parameter values and record only URL origins/paths/shapes.

schema_lessons: capture_browser_scenario requires browser.mode discriminator ('launch' | 'connect'); actions require step_id and action ('wait_for_timeout' uses duration_ms, not timeout_ms); capture is {at_end, events[], network, limits} - screenshot/dom/console/history/storage are snapshot KINDS, not booleans.

capture_parameters_of_note.limitations: max_network_transactions=1024 with default 1MiB network-metadata budget; Resource-timing/analytics traffic consumed part of it. Not observed as truncated ('omissions' empty), but request retention completeness is bounded by REA's event budgets.

limitations: Host reliability: capture_browser_scenario (launch mode) frequently exceeded the MCP client deadline on this Windows host for RTVE; the captain independently reproduced the same failure, so it is an environment limitation of the launch path, not a missing REA capability.

No passive CDP target existed (list_browser_targets -> endpoint_unreachable on 127.0.0.1:9333), so mode:'connect' passive inspection against a pre-started browser was impossible; the user's personal Chrome profile (.chrome-profile) was NOT used.
Event budgets: REA bounds retained network transactions and metadata; 'omissions' was empty for the retained records but retention is not proof of complete traffic capture.

Response bodies, request bodies and header VALUES were never selected, so codecs, encryption (EXT-X-KEY), CORS values and content-type values of media were not observed (for the 3Cat capture only the header NAMES are known).
No video element events (play/pause/seek/error) were captured; recoverable-error classification (autoplay blocked, DRM error, geo error) therefore rests on console/page-error events only.
Time zone of the REA-managed Chromium was fixed to Europe/Madrid and network egress is the host's ISP location; geo-sensitive outcomes were not varied and must not be generalised.
Measurements describe a single point in time (~22:18-22:27Z on 2026-11-16); live players change.

next_steps: Run one Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=<port> and a disposable profile, then use capture_browser_scenario with browser.mode='connect' + the listed target_id (or inspect_web_page / observe_web_session) to observe each player without REA relaunching a browser per target; this removes the launch-path deadline seen on this host.

For each provider, once the page is reachable: capture 20-30 s of network events and select response bodies ONLY for the .m3u8/.mpd manifests, to read EXT-X-KEY/EXT-X-MAP/CODECS or MPD ContentProtection and settle 'clear HLS' vs 'DRM'.
Answer consent walls (Mediaset 'cookieWall', RTVE OneTrust, Atresplayer Didomi) with an explicit human decision recorded in the registry; automation must not fabricate consent.
Capture element events (a play click plus video events) to classify autoplay-blocked vs geoblocked vs DRM-error states per provider.
Complete the untried Spanish targets (ETB, CRTVG, À Punt) and a small LatAm/European sample.
Verify the CCMA manifest hosts difference (observed directes3-tv-es.3catdirectes.cat vs catalogue directes-tv-*.3catdirectes.cat) before registering any playlist URL as a playback source.
